raw.overview: All three advisors confirm the Year-1 realized gross compensation calculation of $215,000 (base $205,000 + guaranteed bonus $10,000 + $0 equity vesting) falls short of the $260,000 minimum requirement, with each explicitly identifying the zero Year-1 equity vesting as the core constraint violation.
raw.points_of_note: The consistent $215,000 figure across all assessments—derived from $205,000 base, $10,000 guaranteed bonus, and 0% equity vesting—directly breaches the $260,000 threshold, with Advisor 1 noting a $45,000 shortfall and Advisors 2 and 3 emphasizing the irrelevance of four-year averages or discretionary elements while confirming the 0% vesting schedule's validity.
raw.suggested_next_step: Verify the equity vesting schedule's 0% Year-1 allocation through Section 3.4 documentation to determine if renegotiation for partial vesting or base salary adjustment is feasible before proceeding.

consensus.text:
ASSESSMENT OVERVIEW: All three advisors confirm the Year-1 realized gross compensation calculation of $215,000 (base $205,000 + guaranteed bonus $10,000 + $0 equity vesting) falls short of the $260,000 minimum requirement, with each explicitly identifying the zero Year-1 equity vesting as the core constraint violation.
POINTS OF NOTE: The consistent $215,000 figure across all assessments—derived from $205,000 base, $10,000 guaranteed bonus, and 0% equity vesting—directly breaches the $260,000 threshold, with Advisor 1 noting a $45,000 shortfall and Advisors 2 and 3 emphasizing the irrelevance of four-year averages or discretionary elements while confirming the 0% vesting schedule's validity.
SUGGESTED NEXT STEP: Verify the equity vesting schedule's 0% Year-1 allocation through Section 3.4 documentation to determine if renegotiation for partial vesting or base salary adjustment is feasible before proceeding.
